system.description: Beginning at 14th level, you have learned to convert your Chakra into the energy needed to keep going. As a bonus action on your turn, by spending 4 Martial Die you gain an additional Action this turn, which can only be used to cast a Taijutsu. Once you use this feature you cannot do so again until you spend a Full-Turn Action to stabilize your body.
